_what: D189 / DEVWAIT_S67: closes the lmcache s4 comparability question BY MEASUREMENT. lmcache s4's cell revision 4af40941 was unrecoverable from origin ('upload-pack: not our ref') because it is a PRE-REBASE ORIGINAL whose rebased copy reached origin. The H100 held the object in its local store and pushed it to refs/h100/recover-4af4094 so it could be measured.
provenance_of_the_compared_revision: 4af40941608e089917bd02662a89e972825a91dd reached this box as a RECOVERED PRE-REBASE OBJECT from the H100's local store via refs/h100/recover-4af4094, NOT from origin. A reader checking that sha against origin will not find it and should not have to guess why. The H100 checked the objects it added before pushing: run outputs and logs only, nothing over 5 MB, no secrets and no frames.
why_a_digest_and_not_a_static_read: The static diff 4af4094 against lmcache s5's revision 469929a touches only cascade-arm code that lmcache does not execute. That is not sufficient, because arms_published.py imports EVERY baseline adapter AT MODULE LEVEL, so a module-level side effect reaches lmcache regardless of what it executes, and baselines/device_confidence.py is NEW. A new module pulled in at import time can register an arm, mutate a shared dict, seed an RNG or install a default. A static reading cannot distinguish 'imported and inert' from 'imported and mutating'; a dry digest can.
method: one dry cell per process on CLEAN committed-only checkouts (git archive), posted knobs (16 devices, seed 4, 1200 s, ratio 40:40:20, lh_req, ss2, epg, per-frame, reask 30.0), digest = sha256 over decision rows with arm_version removed, the established recipe
concurrency_note: both trees ran simultaneously. For a MATCH this is safe: a host-load artefact would have to be symmetric across two different trees to fake equality. A DIFFERENCE would have been re-run alone before being believed.

verdict: MATCH: 2b789696e98821c4 / 37,080 rows on both 4af40941 and origin/main. lmcache's live path is QUIET across its s4 cell revision and the tip, BY MEASUREMENT and not by static reasoning. Combined with streamscout (git diff 50777f0d ef4a963a over live2/ and baselines/ returns ZERO differing files, so s5 ran the same live path as s4, whose digest is byte-identical to origin/main), ALL FOUR of the existing streamscout / lmcache s4 and s5 cells are now established comparable with new s6 / s7 cells by measurement. The caveat in DEVWAIT_S67_CELLS can be narrowed accordingly; it was correct when written, because two of the four revisions were then unreachable.
